### what_to_do_first.details[1]
Sentence: Supported by mentor insight that a weak referral gets a lower specialist urgency rating while occupational health gets patients to specialist care faster, and because regional pathway documents name no diagnostic-phase contact person, the team recommends a standard referral template, referring persistent symptoms after a normal X-ray for pulmonologist assessment, and naming a diagnostic contact person.

### what_to_do_first.details[3]
Sentence: Because lung cancer data collection is incomplete and stage is missing for about 48% of patients, the team recommends publishing county recording completeness for stage, drug treatment, and MDT coding—reading gaps as data-quality signals first—while the STM roadmap plans a national quality registry at 90% coverage under measure 3.2.1 (decree updated by 2026–2028, reporting by 2029–2031).
